name: GENE.01
summary: A Genoa startup carrying the IIT lineage — its physical-AI stack descends from work on iCub, ergoCub and iRonCub — built into a commercial humanoid in six months. The whole body is sensorized: distributed tactile skin with force and proximity sensing fused with vision at high rate, so contact and human presence are anticipated rather than detected after the fact.
notable: Full-body distributed tactile skin for safe human contact
Concept to functional humanoid in six months
Physical-AI stack descended from IIT's iCub and ergoCub
